## Claims
- [source-backed] The original conjecture is that both Theorem 5.4 families  
  \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\) and  
  \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), are minimal. [source-6, lines 14-42]
- [source-backed] The 2024 paper defines \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), works integrally in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), and proves minimality of the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]
- [source-backed] The same paper proves no homogeneous syzygy of the required form and concludes that the lower-adjoined family is minimal. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 819-831]
- [source-backed] For the other, right-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\), the paper states only that its elements are conjugates of the proved family and says one “could” transpose the arguments; this passage is not itself a proof of that family’s minimality. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]
- [proved] Assuming accepted tasks `research-attempt-research-plan-task-301-1` and `research-attempt-research-plan-task-286-1`, partition conjugation gives an integral graded isomorphism from the quotient for \((r,q,i,j)\) to that for \((q,r,j,i)\), sends the right-adjoined family to the lower-adjoined family, and therefore proves right-family minimality from the certified lower-family result.
- [unsupported] A fresh independent adversarial review certifying that the accepted conjugation/descent proof has no missing parameter, ideal-descent, or minimality-transfer hypothesis is not present in the supplied immutable record.

## Strategy
The strongest dependency-closed project argument is accepted task `research-attempt-research-plan-task-334-1`: lower-family minimality follows from the 2024 no-syzygy proof; right-family minimality follows by accepted integral partition-conjugation and the accepted admissibility/descent certificates. No transition matrix is needed.

The source audit confirms all displayed parameters, the integral coefficient setting, the lower-family theorem, and the exact limitation of the published remark concerning the right family.

## Gaps
The required fresh independent adversarial review of the complete two-family proof is missing. Consequently, the original minimality conjecture is **not closed in this task record**, despite the strong accepted conditional proof chain.
